note: The member-name join (an SOS workbook's Kodlista sheets and inline Värdemängd enumerations bound to Variabelnivå rows) seen at the built value sets, one variable per replaced claim. Expected values are the replaced tests' asserted outcomes read through the workbook rows: a bound variable's codes are its list's rows, and a withheld one has no value set. The old tests cut membership at days inside one occurrence; Kodlista_SJUKHUS's Från/Till row validity reaches that grain, so DAY and MONTH keep the replaced test's exact bounds. IDPERIOD, IDCLAMP and IDCLAMPS restate the two drops-only-the-bad-period claims (a member without a label; a member whose validity is unknown) at year grain: a Kodlista member period is a year, while the replaced tests' bad member covered July 2020; an SOS row or section period is the only known window an unknown validity can be clamped to, and it is a year. IDCLAMP clamps to its known section period, IDCLAMPS (unknown section, known row period) to its row period, the replaced test's supplied window. EXPLICIT in VAL_B is the replaced test's second record of the same name, which still binds the list that names it; SUFFIX is its sheet-suffix-only list, which binds nothing. CVALID: a row period (2010) outside its section period (2001-2002) has no common period (conflicting_code_validity). The copy-fingerprint test that once mapped here now maps to coding-checked-entries-apply-then-go-stale-on-drift (docvalid): an SOS list shares its workbook revision with its record, so a list drift stales a documented authority there regardless of its fingerprints.
fails_if: any one of: `_explicit_sheet_member` accepts a case-differing header without an exact unanchored pointer (civilnp or anchored gain Ogift) or stops accepting it with one (civil loses it), accepts a pointer naming another sheet (civilop gains Ogift), matches the pointer case-insensitively (civilcp gains Ogift), drops the header-name check (civilh and civilop gain Ogift), drops both the single-header and the member-reference checks (civilhs reports ambiguous_list_member_references; the two are redundant for this shape, so either one alone still holds it back) or stops checking each row's named variable (civilr reports conflicting_list_member_references); the shared-pointer shape binds a list to every name it lists rather than only to the rows that point at it (outsider gains Delad), keys a shared pointer by source and member name instead of the pointed-at locator (FIRST's VAL_B row gains 1 Delad), or is treated as ambiguous (first and second lose it); a list naming two variables binds instead of reporting ambiguous_list_member_references (ambiga, ambigb); a row naming another variable than its header binds (conflict gains 1); inline enumerations bind by member name instead of record id (the VAL_B inline row gains 1 Ett and 2 Två); member names bind across workbooks (oth's explicit gains Ett); a list naming a variable binds only one of that variable's records (explicit's VAL_B row loses 1 Ett); a sheet suffix binds a list that names no variable (suffix gains 1 Ett; its unresolved_list_reference stays); an unresolved enumeration publishes a partial list (unresolved); `value_window` loses day precision, reads yyyymm as a year or accepts an impossible or reversed bound (day, month, baddate, reversed); row and section periods with no overlap bind instead of conflicting (cvalid); or the declared-identifier drop is lifted (idperiod reports 2020; idday reports 02-29..03-01) or widened from the invalid member's window to its whole calendar year (idday loses A for all of 2020) or extended to the identifier's own inline enumeration (idinline loses its issue); or an identifier member with unknown validity is widened from its known section period to the whole occurrence (idclamp loses 0 for 2019 and 2021) or no longer dropped (idclamp reports 2020); or the clamp ignores a known row period (idclamps' unknown member widens to 2019-2021, so 0 is lost for 2019 and 2021); or one record's linkage mark decides the identifier drop for its whole column (idmix's peer row loses its claim and unknown_code_membership)
